title: Ultari Proof Anatomy: 5-Gate Technical Audit & Formal Dissection Archive for Frontier Mathematical & Code Verification Corpora (v1.0.3)
description: Byte-level zero-truncation technical audit and standalone Lean 4 reconstruction of frontier AI and classical mathematical formal verification corpora (15 case studies, 892 standalone Lean 4 theorems with 0 sorry and 0 axiom, 4,217/4,217 hypothesis mutations killed, covering 44,833 distinct upstream .lean files and 49,969 cumulative per-case file-audits across >12.4M lines) under the project's 5-Gate Audit Rubric (OPFF) synthesizing COPE, IMU/AMS/EMS, ACM Artifact Review v1.1, ICMJE/NISO CRediT, and NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR guidelines.
